about_the_game:
Magical Showdown is a team-based arena brawler all about Magical Girls (and others) beating the snot out of anything in their way to make some cash! Take a team of three, and plunge into a battle against three OTHER teams of three to accomplish the given objective! Fight, run, and strategize in order to take down all comers and win the Showdown- where the most precious prize to be won is up for grabs...

Fast and furious combat!

Pick a character, and go in with wicked melee combat- to accomplish your goals, you'll have to get up close and personal! With a variety of attacks and defensive measures, you'll have to fight fast and fight smart to succeed and take down your enemies.

Priority 1: Accomplish the Objective!

There will be several modes available- but all of them a centered around an important objective that your team will NEED to accomplish if you want to win, so don't just worry about beating down your rivals! While that'll certainly help, there are OTHER targets that need your attention, so be sure you split your time between business and pleasure carefully!

The Right Girl (or Guy) in the Right Place!

Each character has a unique fighting style and skills they're bringing to the table; from in-your -face brawlers, to defensive walls, to debilitating support players, you're sure to find someone who resonates with you. Make sure to look carefully and find a character that fits YOUR playstyle!

Always Bring Supplies!

Before every battle, you'll be able to outfit your character with up to three pieces of Gear. These pieces of gear will modify your playstyle in a variety of ways, whether it's allowing you to double jump, making your dodges more effective, or just adding some extra oomph to your offensive power. The right gear in the right situation can turn what would be a crushing defeat into a resounding victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Magical Showdown is an arena brawler all about Magical Girls! With a colorful team of three, fight against three other teams and unruly enemies in order to accomplish the given objective, win the Showdown, and take home the prize! Remember- magical girls know how to put on a show!
